subject: QMon runbook alignment: prompt sets, eval harness, canary & rollback
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Carter <olivia@heliohealth.com>, Carey Mendoza <carey@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: QMon runbook alignment: prompt sets, eval harness, canary & rollback

Hi Olivia / Carey —

Thanks again for the onboarding sync last week. To make the implementation sprint productive, I wanted to lock in the Quality Monitoring (QMon) setup plan so the integration and first canary run are unambiguous. Please find the immediate asks below and an attached checklist + our initial prompt set sample.

Summary of what we need from Helio Health this week:
- Confirm the canonical prompt sets you want monitored (attach current .csv) — we got a sample but need production prompts and typical traffic slices.
- Provide 1–2 representative evaluation endpoints (API routes) and expected success signals (e.g., intent match, regulatory flag count).
- Point of contact for security/PII review if different from Carey.

Redwood deliverables / proposed schedule:
- Day 0–3: Ingest prompt sets + map to eval harness (owner: Neha)
- Day 4–7: Baseline evals and threshold proposal + canary config (owner: Marissa)
- Day 8: Canary run start (traffic split 1%) — automated rollback triggers defined
- Day 9: Expand canary to 10% if no regressions; full ramp by Day 14

Canary / rollback specifics I propose now (we can update based on your constraints):
- Canary window: 24h rolling. Regression alert triggers: >4% relative drop in intent-match, >1.5% increase in safety flags, or sustained latency p95 > 600ms for 30+ minutes.
- Automated rollback: any single trigger + manual approval option.

Attachments: qmon-integration-checklist.xlsx (checklist for infra/keys/routes), initial_promptset_v1.csv (example).

Next steps: Can you attach the current production prompt set and confirm the preferred canary start date? If Aug 10 works, we will lock resources and send the final runbook by Aug 3.

Thanks,
Priyom
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Carter <olivia@heliohealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Cc: Carey Mendoza <carey@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon runbook alignment: prompt sets, eval harness, canary & rollback

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear plan. Attaching our current prompt CSV; it contains 1,200 unique prompts across triage and follow-up flows (file: helio-current-promptset.csv). A few notes:
- We have redaction in-flight for patient names; prompts marked with "PHI" in column F should be omitted from test sets until we finish that pass.
- Our security lead is Carey Mendoza (copied). He will validate KMS/HSM requirements and confirm if we need a dedicated VPC for logs.

Aug 10 sounds reasonable for a low-traffic canary. Can we aim for the baseline evals to finish by Aug 3 so we have thresholds defined? Also want to confirm that rollback will not automatically purge cached embeddings or other state we need — we prefer a non-destructive rollback.

Olivia
Director, Product Ops
Helio Health

Attachments: helio-current-promptset.csv
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: QMon runbook alignment: prompt sets, eval harness, canary & rollback

Priyom / team —

I pulled the sample and started mapping to our eval harness. Quick items:
- I’ll own ingestion and mapping (ETA Aug 2). I need the PHI column guidance — will omit rows flagged "PHI" per Olivia.
- For evals, we’ll run three signal families: intent-match (clf), safety flags (heuristic + model), and latency distribution. We’ll produce a thresholds proposal (baseline ± tolerance) by Aug 2.
- Tech note: please ensure Helio provides API keys with a test role that has the same rate limits as prod; that helps us emulate realistic latency patterns.

On quoting Priyom below for context: 
> Canary / rollback specifics I propose now (we can update based on your constraints):
> - Canary window: 24h rolling. Regression alert triggers: >4% relative drop in intent-match, >1.5% increase in safety flags, or sustained latency p95 > 600ms for 30+ minutes.

I’ll post the thresholds doc to the shared drive link and ping when ready.

Neha
Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Carter <olivia@heliohealth.com>, Carey Mendoza <carey@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon runbook alignment: prompt sets, eval harness, canary & rollback

Team —

Short update and confirmed owners:
- Neha: ingest + thresholds (deliverable: thresholds_proposal_helio_v1.md) — due 2027-08-02 EOD PST
- Marissa: canary orchestration + rollback scripts and runbook (deliverable: canary-runbook-helio-v1.md) — due 2027-08-03 EOD PST
- Dylan: monitoring dashboards & alert routing rules (pager/escalation) — Due 2027-08-04

Docs/links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521-RDW-6421); shared runbook folder is the Drive link I included in the checklist.

About rollback: we will implement a non-destructive rollback (route traffic back to previous model variant + preserve caches). We will not wipe embeddings or logs automatically. Marissa will include steps and safety checks in the runbook.

Proposed schedule:
- Aug 2: thresholds proposal complete
- Aug 3: final runbook + pre-canary checklist sign-off
- Aug 10: start 1% canary (24h window)

Olivia — please confirm Aug 10 and that Carey has what he needs for the security review. If confirmed, I’ll create the canary job and notify infra.

Thanks,
Priyom
From: Olivia Carter <olivia@heliohealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Cc: Carey Mendoza <carey@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon runbook alignment: prompt sets, eval harness, canary & rollback

Priyom —

Confirming Aug 10 for the 1% canary. Carey has everything he needs for an initial security pass; he’ll follow up separately about KMS scope but confirmed it won’t block the canary. The PHI-tagged prompts will be excluded from the first canary.

One last ask: can you add a short note in the runbook about how we’ll handle drift alerts that trigger outside business hours (we prefer email + summary deck to on-call page).

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

—Olivia
